what: Leaf art placed at the section edges falls straight from top to bottom (18~28s linear: appears at 10%, stays clear until 30%, vanishes at 70% as it reaches 40em below) while swinging 12em left and right in a 3.5~8s ease-in-out back and forth and rotating 45°. Because the fall and the sway have different tempos, each leaf seems to take a different path.

options.--fx-dur: Duration of one fall, default 20s (original 18~28s per leaf)
options.look: back: Reverse — from -45° pushed back 20em to its place (original sway2)
options.look: tilt: Comes into place from 16em with a 45° tilt (original sway3)

from.where: index.html·recruit.html .as-fall (ten watercolor leaves falling between sections — original .leaffall_* : animation fall 18~28s linear infinite + sway·sway2·sway3·sway5 3.5~8s ease-in-out infinite alternate, fall 0% top 10em·10% opacity 1·30% 1·70% top 50em opacity 0)

note: CSS only — set the parent to position: relative and place the leaves with left/right. The falling distance scales with the font size (em)
